title: Section 113 BNS incorporates the substantive offence of a Terrorist Act into India’s general penal code for the first time in history

content.overview: Section 113 BNS incorporates the substantive offence of a Terrorist Act into India’s general penal code for the first time in history. It penalizes acts threatening the unity, integrity, sovereignty, security, or economic security of India, or intended to strike terror through lethal weaponry, hazardous materials, counterfeit currency, kidnapping, or overawing public functionaries. It establishes seven severe tiers of punishment (including capital punishment where death results) and erects a vital jurisdictional gateway in the Explanation requiring an officer not below Superintendent of Police (SP) to decide whether to register under Section 113 BNS or under the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act, 1967.
